note: Single web-search-with-citations provider backs image_match, retail_price, and resale_price (resale_listing_ai/adapters.py).
override: Set RESALE_LISTING_AI_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER at runtime to override this default without editing config.
vision_note: vision_identify and image_process's classify step share one provider (resale_listing_ai/adapters.py's _vision_provider()) — both are single/multi-image-in, structured-JSON-out calls.
vision_override: Set RESALE_LISTING_AI_VISION_PROVIDER at runtime to override this default without editing config.
copy_override: Set RESALE_LISTING_AI_COPY_PROVIDER at runtime to override this default without editing config.
image_process_note: image_process's provider (resale_listing_ai/adapters.py's _image_process_provider()) — background removal + tape/clutter inpaint for finished listing images.
image_process_override: Set RESALE_LISTING_AI_IMAGE_PROCESS_PROVIDER at runtime to override this default without editing config.
hero_generate_note: AI website-hero generation provider (resale_listing_ai/adapters.py's _hero_generate_provider()). Text-to-image; only gemini is wired today.
hero_generate_override: Set RESALE_LISTING_AI_HERO_GENERATE_PROVIDER at runtime to override this default without editing config.
hero_persist_prompt_note: Persist the exact text-to-image prompt used for each AI website hero onto the product record (WebsiteHeroPrompt) for audit/tuning. On by default.
hero_persist_prompt_override: Set RESALE_LISTING_AI_PERSIST_HERO_PROMPT=0 (or the provider_stack.hero_persist_prompt admin override) to disable.
json_repair_note: The JSON-repair/normalizer step (resale_listing_ai/json_repair.py) that coerces raw model output onto our schemas at each stage boundary. Not tied to one vendor — swap via config or env, same seam as web_search_provider.
json_repair_override: Set RESALE_LISTING_AI_JSON_REPAIR_PROVIDER at runtime to override this default without editing config.
